chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Meeting Wes Helvey through Clarence Page
summary: A neighbor, saxophonist Clarence Page, heard him practice and introduced him to Helvey.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: How did you meet Wes Helvey?
I went to visit my sister and Clarence Page who lived next door, he had a band and he heard me practice. So he told Wes Helvey about me.
He played sax, tenor sax. He had his own band.
And he introduced you to Wes Helvey?
Who was in that band with Wes Helvey?
Uh-oh, let's see, we got a fellow work here now. He works here where Samuel works, on the elevator - Henry Jameson.
He works on the elevator there.
Right here where Sandy Williams works, on - what street is that ninety something Street; and Edgan Courance, tenor sax player -
